events.title: Northwest Natural (NWN) Surpasses Q1 Earnings Estimates
events.body: Northwest Natural (NWN) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +0.87% and -2.77%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: Southwest Gas Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Decline Y/Y
events.body: SWX beat Q1 earnings estimates as operating income rises, though revenues and system throughput decline from last year.

events.title: ONE Gas Q1 Earnings & Revenues Miss Estimates, Sales Decline Y/Y
events.body: OGS misses Q1 earnings and revenue estimates as sales and natural gas volumes decline year over year despite higher operating income.

events.title: Southwest Gas (SWX) Tops Q1 Earnings Estimates
events.body: Southwest Gas (SWX) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +1.60% and -20.61%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
